checkpoints.description: Task 'licensing-v6' completed successfully.
[1/2] Remove the last reference/browser divergences and fail closed on a missing register

impact_assessment.why: Python and the website disagreed on an explicitly empty license_type, missing projects, non-hyphenated dates, register digest casing and non-text register fields; the CLI also turned a mistyped --register path into UNREGISTERED instead of an error.
impact_assessment.benefits: The same certificate returns the same status in both implementations, and a missing register path cannot be mistaken for a valid empty register.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: stricter validation for malformed input only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no register format change; compatibility: an explicit missing register path now exits 1 with an error
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pin each divergence in both Python and Node suites; keep load_register's empty result for register creation; run both gates.

checkpoints.description: Task 'licensing-v7' completed successfully.
[1/3] Bound canonical numbers, fail on a missing register, and enforce the scope vocabulary

impact_assessment.why: Python and JavaScript disagreed on integral floats, integers beyond 2^53 and U+007F; a explicitly missing register path was reported as UNREGISTERED; and verification did not check the certificate scope even though issuance restricts it.
impact_assessment.benefits: Canonical bytes and status now match the browser, a mistyped register path is a clear error, and a scope the agreement does not define is refused in both verifiers.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: stricter validation for malformed input only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: the conformance vector digest changes and the tests now use an empty register file for UNREGISTERED; compatibility: existing certificates have string fields and a registered scope
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add numeric, control, BOM, nested-key and missing-register tests; update the conformance vector and specification; run the Python suite and the website parity suite.
